description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.3.9 - Patch Update
🚀 New
- Settings button to toggle off Bug Report button, Tray Button and Langugage button from Titlebar
🐛 Fixes
- Word Wrapping for other Languages, so they don't clip out
✨ Improvements
- Changed Saved Directory Name
- Deleted Duplicated files, Merged some files
- Removed Classic UI from the App
⚠️ Known Issues
- Save Data folder has been renamed from com.ryko.godothub to Ryko.GodotHub, So you might need to re-setup your GodotHub :D
